<!-- Generated by Kora's design director. This is the design decision the site was built
     from. Business: Newport Sailing School and Tours -->

# DESIGN.md — Newport Sailing School and Tours

archetype: approachable-local
rationale: Fifty-plus years of family ownership, a captain named Mike who recommends local restaurants to guests, and reviews that read like postcards from a friend — this is a neighbourhood business built on personal trust, and the approachable-local direction amplifies that warmth while the deep navy palette and coastal imagery give it the upscale edge the brand mood calls for.
interaction_level: L2

personality: [warm, trustworthy, coastal, personal]

typography:
  display: "Rozha One"
  body: "Inter"
  scale: 1.250
  notes: "Display h1 at 3.5rem, h2 at 2.25rem, h3 at 1.5rem, body at 1.125rem / 1.75 line-height. Section eyebrows in Inter small-caps at 0.75rem, letter-spacing 0.12em. The phone number in the hero and footer is set at 1.75rem in Rozha One — it is a display element, not body text."

palette:
  primary: "#1b3a5b"
  secondary: "#efe9e6"
  accent: "#aa2b2b"
  application: "Primary (#1b3a5b) carries the header, the footer, and tinted section bands. Secondary (#efe9e6) is the page ground and alternating section backgrounds. Accent (#aa2b2b) is reserved for the single booking CTA button and the pulled-quote rule — nowhere else. Type on primary bands is white; type on secondary ground is #1b3a5b."

composition:
  whitespace: balanced
  photography: dominant
  card_usage: none
  mobile: "Header collapses to logo left / hamburger right; nav opens as a full-width drawer in primary (#1b3a5b) with white links stacked at 1.5rem. Hero image crops to 16:9 above the text block rather than behind it. Services section becomes a single column with hairline rules between items. Gallery filmstrip scrolls horizontally. Reviews stack to a single column. Footer stacks into a single centred column."

shell:
  header: |
    Sticky. Height 72px. Horizontal padding 2rem each side. Background #1b3a5b. On scroll past 80px the header gains a subtle box-shadow (0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)) — no colour or height change.
    Left: logo image (https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/social-media/21687d38-571e-42df-85a3-91d9855b80ed/medialibrary/1788850116_m0sgdh.png) at 44px height, linking to index.html.
    Centre: nav links — "Home" · "Services" · "About" · "Gallery" · "Contact" — in Inter, 0.875rem, font-weight 500, colour #efe9e6, letter-spacing 0.04em, uppercase via CSS text-transform: uppercase. Gap between items: 2rem. Active page link has a 2px accent (#aa2b2b) underline offset 4px below.
    Right: one button — label "Book Now" — background #aa2b2b, colour #ffffff, font Inter 0.875rem font-weight 600, padding 0.6rem 1.4rem, border-radius 4px, links to https://www.newportsailing.com/online-booking. No other CTAs in the header.
    Mobile (below 768px): logo left, hamburger icon right (three horizontal lines, colour #efe9e6). Nav drawer slides in from right, full viewport height, background #1b3a5b, links stacked with 2rem vertical gap, centred, Inter 1.25rem uppercase. "Book Now" button appears at the bottom of the drawer.
  nav: ["Home", "Services", "About", "Gallery", "Contact"]
  footer: |
    Background #1b3a5b. Two-column grid on desktop (left column 55%, right column 45%), single centred column on mobile. Vertical padding 3.5rem top and bottom. Horizontal padding 2rem.

    LEFT COLUMN:
    Business name set in Rozha One 1.5rem, colour #ffffff, as the literal string: "Newport Sailing School and Tours"
    Tagline set in Inter 0.875rem, colour #efe9e6, italic, below the name: "Newport's Finest Since 1971"
    Address block below, set in Inter 0.875rem, colour #efe9e6, line-height 1.6, as the literal two-line string:
      "5 Marina Plaza, Goat Island Marina, Dock A5"
      "Newport, RI 02840"
    Phone below the address, set in Rozha One 1.25rem, colour #ffffff, as a tappable tel link: "(401) 848-2266"
    Email below, set in Inter 0.875rem, colour #efe9e6, as a mailto link: "info@newportsailing.com"

    RIGHT COLUMN:
    Small-caps eyebrow in Inter 0.7rem, letter-spacing 0.12em, colour #efe9e6, text-transform: uppercase: "Quick Links"
    Nav repeat — five items stacked, Inter 0.875rem, colour #efe9e6, line-height 2.2, no bullets: "Home" · "Services" · "About" · "Gallery" · "Contact"

    BOTTOM RULE:
    A 1px hairline rule in rgba(255,255,255,0.15) spanning full width, then a single centred line in Inter 0.75rem colour rgba(239,233,230,0.6): "© 2025 Newport Sailing School and Tours. All rights reserved."

pages:
  - slug: services
    title: "Sailing Tours, Lessons & Team Building — Newport Sailing School"
    description: "Explore sailing tours, instruction courses, team building events and custom sails departing from Goat Island Marina in Newport, RI. Book online or call (401) 848-2266."
    h1: "Our Sailing Services"
    intent: "What experiences do you offer, and what do they cost?"
    takes: [offerings]
    sources:
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/services
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/sailing-tours
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/sailing-instruction
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/team-building
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/custom-sailing

  - slug: about
    title: "About Newport Sailing School and Tours — Newport's Finest Since 1971"
    description: "Family owned and operated since 1965, Newport Sailing School and Tours is Newport, RI's first and only pure sailing tour. Meet the crew and learn our story."
    h1: "About Newport Sailing School and Tours"
    intent: "Who are these people and can I trust them?"
    takes: [story]
    sources:
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/about-us
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/about

  - slug: gallery
    title: "Photo Gallery — Newport Sailing School and Tours"
    description: "Browse photos of sailing on Newport Harbor and Narragansett Bay with Newport Sailing School and Tours. See the boats, the crew and the scenery."
    h1: "Gallery"
    intent: "What does a sail with you actually look like?"
    takes: [gallery]
    sources:
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/gallery
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/gallery-2

  - slug: contact
    title: "Contact Newport Sailing School and Tours — Newport, RI"
    description: "Get in touch with Newport Sailing School and Tours. Call (401) 848-2266, email info@newportsailing.com, or send a message. Located at Goat Island Marina, Dock A5."
    h1: "Contact Our Crew"
    intent: "How do I reach someone to ask a question or make a booking?"
    takes: [contact]
    sources:
      - https://www.newportsailing.com/contact-3

sections:
  - id: hero
    layout: full-bleed-image
    show: all
    spec: "Full-bleed photograph (https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/user-media/21687d38-571e-42df-85a3-91d9855b80ed/de8c94d8-887e-4625-825f-ec262dbc28df/1788867648_gr31jv.jpg) edge to edge, minimum 90vh tall, with a dark gradient overlay running from rgba(27,58,91,0.25) at the top to rgba(27,58,91,0.72) at the bottom. All text anchored to the lower-left third of the frame with 3rem left padding and 3.5rem bottom padding. Headline in Rozha One at 4rem, colour #ffffff, line-height 1.1: 'Experience Newport the Way It Should Be Seen: Under Sail'. Below it, one line in Inter 1.125rem colour rgba(239,233,230,0.9): 'Sailing tours, lessons and custom experiences departing from Goat Island Marina since 1971.' Below that, one accent button (#aa2b2b, white text, Inter 0.9rem font-weight 600, padding 0.75rem 2rem, border-radius 4px) labelled 'Book Now' linking to https://www.newportsailing.com/online-booking. Nothing else in the frame — no sub-navigation, no second button. On mobile: image crops to 16:9 and sits above the text block (not behind it); text block on secondary ground (#efe9e6) with primary (#1b3a5b) type; headline drops to 2.25rem; button full-width."

  - id: offerings
    layout: editorial-list
    show: "4 of 4, all items, links to services.html"
    spec: "Primary (#1b3a5b) tinted band at full width, padding 4rem 2rem. Section eyebrow in Inter small-caps 0.75rem letter-spacing 0.12em colour rgba(239,233,230,0.7) text-transform uppercase: 'What We Offer'. Section heading in Rozha One 2.25rem colour #ffffff: 'Our Sailing Services'. Below the heading, two columns on desktop (each 50% minus 2rem gutter), one column on mobile. Each service category is introduced by its name as a small-caps eyebrow in Inter 0.75rem letter-spacing 0.12em colour rgba(239,233,230,0.7) with a 1px hairline rule (#efe9e6 at 0.2 opacity) beneath it. Under each category heading, individual items (where they exist) are listed with the item name in Inter 1rem font-weight 600 colour #ffffff and the price right-aligned on the same baseline in Inter 0.875rem colour #efe9e6; a dotted leader in rgba(239,233,230,0.3) spans between them. The item description sits on the line below the name in Inter 0.875rem colour rgba(239,233,230,0.75). Categories with no individual items (Team Building, Custom Sailing Experience) show their category description in Inter 0.9rem colour rgba(239,233,230,0.85) beneath the eyebrow rule, with a line 'Call for rates and availability' in Inter 0.8rem italic colour rgba(239,233,230,0.6). No images, no cards, no borders around rows. A single accent-coloured text link at the bottom right of the section: 'View full services →' linking to services.html, in Inter 0.875rem font-weight 600 colour #aa2b2b — this is the only accent element in the section."

  - id: story
    layout: quote-led
    show: all
    spec: "Secondary ground (#efe9e6) full-width band, padding 5rem 2rem. Two-column asymmetric layout on desktop: left column 40% carries a single photograph (https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/user-media/21687d38-571e-42df-85a3-91d9855b80ed/de8c94d8-887e-4625-825f-ec262dbc28df/1788867647_k3d4jf.webp) at full column width, aspect ratio 4:5, object-fit cover, no border-radius, no shadow. Right column 60% (with 3rem left padding) carries: a small-caps eyebrow in Inter 0.75rem letter-spacing 0.12em colour #1b3a5b text-transform uppercase: 'Our Story'; below it the heading in Rozha One 2rem colour #1b3a5b: 'Newport's First and Only Pure Sailing Tour'; below that the about text in Inter 1rem colour #1b3a5b line-height 1.75, drawn from the about.story field; below that a short credential line in Inter 0.875rem font-weight 600 colour #1b3a5b: 'Family owned and operated since 1965 · ASA Certified'. No button in this section. On mobile: image sits above the text block at 16:9 aspect ratio; text block full width."

  - id: gallery
    layout: filmstrip
    show: "6 of 8, links to gallery.html"
    spec: "White ground band, padding 3rem 0. Section heading in Rozha One 2rem colour #1b3a5b, centred, with 2rem horizontal padding: 'Life on the Water'. Below it, a horizontally scrolling filmstrip at full viewport width, no side padding. Six images displayed at fixed height 320px, width auto (approximately 480px each), object-fit cover, gap 0.75rem between images, the strip cropped at both edges to signal scrollability. Images used in order: the first six gallery URLs from the gallery array. On desktop the strip still scrolls horizontally — it is not a grid. A text link centred below the strip: 'See all photos →' linking to gallery.html, in Inter 0.875rem font-weight 600 colour #1b3a5b. On mobile: image height drops to 220px."

  - id: reviews
    layout: pulled-quote
    show: all
    spec: "Primary (#1b3a5b) full-width band, padding 5rem 2rem. One review pulled large: the Trent Bouvet review ('Did a tour with Newport sailing and it was easily the highlight of my east coast road trip…') set in Rozha One 1.875rem colour #ffffff, max-width 44rem, centred, with a 3px accent (#aa2b2b) rule 2rem above it (40px wide, centred). Attribution below in Inter 0.8rem colour rgba(239,233,230,0.8) small-caps letter-spacing 0.1em: '— Trent Bouvet'. Below that, the remaining four reviews arranged in a two-column grid on desktop, single column on mobile, each as a plain text block: review text in Inter 0.9rem colour rgba(239,233,230,0.85) line-height 1.6, attribution below in Inter 0.75rem colour rgba(239,233,230,0.6) small-caps. Columns separated by a 1px hairline rule rgba(255,255,255,0.12). No star graphics, no avatar images, no card borders."

  - id: hours_location
    layout: stacked-band
    show: all
    spec: "Secondary ground (#efe9e6) full-width band, padding 4rem 2rem. Two columns on desktop (each 50%), single column on mobile. Left column: small-caps eyebrow 'Find Us' in Inter 0.75rem letter-spacing 0.12em colour #1b3a5b text-transform uppercase; below it the address set as a real address block in Inter 1rem colour #1b3a5b line-height 1.8 — 'Newport Sailing School and Tours' in font-weight 700 on the first line, then '5 Marina Plaza, Goat Island Marina, Dock A5' on the second line, then 'Newport, RI 02840' on the third line. Below the address: 'Free parking available at our kiosk.' in Inter 0.875rem italic colour #1b3a5b. Right column: small-caps eyebrow 'Get in Touch' in Inter 0.75rem letter-spacing 0.12em colour #1b3a5b text-transform uppercase; below it the phone in Rozha One 1.75rem colour #1b3a5b as a tappable tel link: '(401) 848-2266'; below that the email in Inter 0.9rem colour #1b3a5b as a mailto link: 'info@newportsailing.com'; below that one accent button (#aa2b2b, white text, Inter 0.875rem font-weight 600, padding 0.65rem 1.75rem, border-radius 4px) labelled 'Book Now' linking to https://www.newportsailing.com/online-booking. No map embed on the homepage — map appears on the contact page. On mobile: left column stacks above right column with 2rem gap between them."

  - id: contact
    layout: minimal-band
    show: all
    spec: "This section appears on the homepage as a quiet closing band only — a full contact form lives on contact.html. White ground, padding 3rem 2rem, centred. One line in Rozha One 1.5rem colour #1b3a5b: 'Questions? Our crew is here to help.' Below it, two inline links side by side (separated by a middot ·) in Inter 0.9rem colour #1b3a5b: '(401) 848-2266' as a tel link and 'info@newportsailing.com' as a mailto link. Below those, one accent button (#aa2b2b, white text, Inter 0.875rem font-weight 600, padding 0.65rem 1.75rem, border-radius 4px) labelled 'Send Us a Message' linking to contact.html."

avoid:
  - A three-column icon grid of "Safe · Experienced · Certified" — the highlights are woven into the story and reviews sections, not presented as badge graphics
  - Stock photography of any kind — only the provided image URLs appear on this site
  - A carousel or auto-advancing slideshow anywhere on the page
  - The word "solutions" or any corporate B2B language
  - Centred hero layout with headline over three equal cards below it
  - Gradient overlays using any colour outside the palette
  - Drop shadows on images or section containers
  - Rounded corners on photographs
  - Any section numbered 01 / 02 / 03 — the services are not a sequence
  - A second CTA button placed beside "Book Now" in the header
